name: Resident Alien
description: Crash-landed alien Harry takes on the identity of a small-town Colorado doctor. Arriving with a secret mission, he starts off living a simple life…but things get a bit rocky when he’s roped into solving a local murder and realizes he needs to assimilate into his new world. As he does, he begins to wrestle with the moral dilemma of his mission and asking the big life questions like: “Are human beings worth saving?” and “Why do they fold their pizza before eating it?”

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Stranded in the town of Patience, Colorado, an alien inhabits the body of Dr. Harry Venderspeigle — but one resident can see past his façade.

videos.title: Homesick
videos.overview: In his first week at the clinic, Harry struggles to diagnose a strange feeling: human emotion.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: Harry races to keep his secret safe as Asta is forced to face her own past.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Harry travels to the Ute Reservation to help Asta's grandmother, and along the way, learns what it means to belong to a community.

videos.title: Love Language
videos.overview: A surprise visitor gives Harry an introduction to marriage, a stressful human institution he needs to familiarize himself with.

videos.title: Sexy Beast
videos.overview: Harry copes with jealousy when the mayor hires an annoyingly perfect new town doctor.

videos.title: The Green Glow
videos.overview: After he makes a mess of his human life, a depressed Harry gets drunk. Liv quits the force when Mike fails to credit her for solving a crime.

videos.title: End of the World as We Know It
videos.overview: Asta saves a badly injured Harry after they fall into a glacial crevasse — and in the process learns a shocking secret.

videos.title: Welcome Aliens
videos.overview: To repair his planet-killing device, Harry visits an alien convention to harvest implants from UFO abductees. Mike asks Liv to rejoin the department.

videos.title: Heroes of Patience
videos.overview: Brokenhearted when Asta ends their friendship after discovering the real Harry’s fate, the alien decides to fulfill his original mission.

videos.title: Old Friends
videos.overview: Harry the alien is back on Earth and doesn't remember who he is, and only Asta can keep him safe.

videos.title: The Wire
videos.overview: Harry has a plan to save Asta and himself but he must first attend the Sheriff's poker game.

videos.title: Girls' Night
videos.overview: Harry meets a woman unlike any other and realizes that she is the key to his new mission.

videos.title: Radio Harry
videos.overview: Is Harry building another bomb? Asta is going to find out as they go camping on the reservation.

videos.title: Family Day
videos.overview: Harry and Asta's trip is interrupted by an uninvited relative as the town celebrates family.

videos.title: An Alien in New York
videos.overview: Harry and Asta travel to New York looking for one of his people, but things go horribly wrong.

videos.title: Escape from New York
videos.overview: Harry and Asta find what they are looking for but not what they need as danger closes in.

videos.title: Alien Dinner Party
videos.overview: It's a surprise party as everyone gathers to celebrate Harry, but some dangerous guests cause havoc.

videos.title: Autopsy
videos.overview: Asta is overwhelmed with guilt after she, Harry, and D'arcy get rid of the dead body.

videos.title: The Ghost of Bobby Smallwood
videos.overview: Asta helps Harry learn how to deal with his newfound fear of death.

videos.title: The Weight
videos.overview: Asta tells Dan about the shooting while Harry learns what it takes to be a good friend.

videos.title: The Alien Within
videos.overview: Halloween comes to Patience, and Harry sheds his human mask. Meanwhile, Ben is trying to promote the new resort to the residents of Patience and meets some resistance.

videos.title: Harry, a Parent
videos.overview: After losing the alien baby, Harry learns which alien race is on Earth and it’s not what he expected.

videos.title: Cat and Mouse
videos.overview: Harry goes head-to-head with one of his biggest enemies.

videos.title: Best of Enemies
videos.overview: Harry has an unexpected partner as he tries to infiltrate a military base to find his alien baby. Meanwhile, Asta and Dan help D'arcy to recover and realize, that she's unwilling to leave her new comfort zone.

videos.title: I Believe in Aliens
videos.overview: Harry comes face to face with his greatest enemy and makes a choice that may affect Earth forever.

videos.title: Lone Wolf
videos.overview: In an attempt to gather information on the Grey Aliens, Harry puts Asta in harm's way.

videos.title: The Upper Hand
videos.overview: D'Arcy inserts herself into Harry's mission, while Kate grows more uncomfortable in her own home.

videos.title: 141 Seconds
videos.overview: Harry tags along on Ben, Kate and Max's family trip, hoping the mayor will lead him to answers.

videos.title: Avian Flu
videos.overview: Harry gets distracted from his mission, while Mike and Liv make a huge discovery.

videos.title: Lovebird
videos.overview: Asta and D'Arcy take a drastic step in an attempt to get Harry back on track.

videos.title: Bye Bye Birdie
videos.overview: Harry hits rock bottom, Kate begins seeing the truth, and Mike helps Liv face her greatest fear.

videos.title: Here Comes My Baby
videos.overview: Harry and Asta get surprise visits. Ben grows suspicious of Mike and Liv's private investigation.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Harry and Asta team up with an unlikely ally to try to save the Earth.

videos.title: Prisoners
videos.overview: Harry must escape an outer space prison to stop a dangerous threat in town.

videos.title: The Lonely Man
videos.overview: Harry and Asta work together to try and get something Harry desperately needs.

videos.title: Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Harry and D'arcy travel to an unexpected place to recover an alien device left behind by his people.

videos.title: Truth Hurts
videos.overview: Harry and Heather reunite, but their relationship is more complicated than ever.

videos.title: The Human Condition
videos.overview: Harry struggles to find balance with his new human form.

videos.title: Soul Providers
videos.overview: Harry is brought in front of The Galactic Housing Council to answer for his crimes.

videos.title: Daddy Issues
videos.overview: Harry has to prove himself to someone from his past.

videos.title: Mine Town
videos.overview: Harry enlists an unlikely ally to help him save Patience.

videos.title: Tunnel Vision
videos.overview: With lives hanging in the balance, Harry is put to the test.

videos.title: The End Is Here
videos.overview: Harry faces one final threat, and one that forces him to use more than just his alien strength.
